outreach_drafts.subject: Maria, thank you for being part of Give Miami Day
outreach_drafts.body:
Dear Maria,

Thank you for giving through Give Miami Day each November in 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025. We’re grateful for your steady commitment to Miami.

Here’s what we’ve been doing: The Miami Foundation hosted two in-person SET Summits in Wynwood and Homestead to prepare nonprofits for Give Miami Day.

We also partnered with McDermott Will & Schulte to provide free legal counsel to 17 Miami nonprofits, delivering 398 hours of service valued at more than $500,000. And we committed $100,000 to support Spanish-language coverage through elTOQUE and City of Miami coverage through The Florida Trib in partnership with the Coconut Grove Spotlight.

Will you make a Give Miami Day gift at givemiamiday.org when early giving opens Saturday, November 14, 2026?

Everyone has a role to play. Thank you for the role you’ve played year after year—and for considering being part of this local celebration again.

Warmly,
The Miami Foundation’s Philanthropy Team

Dear Biscayne Harbor Family Foundation team,

Thank you for your partnership and support of The Miami Foundation.

More recently, The Miami Foundation partnered with McDermott Will & Schulte to provide free legal counsel to 17 Miami nonprofits, delivering 398 hours of service valued at more than $500,000.

The Foundation also committed $100,000 to support Spanish-language coverage through elTOQUE and City of Miami coverage through The Florida Trib in partnership with the Coconut Grove Spotlight.

Everyone has a role to play. With Give Miami Day approaching, would you be open to a call or coffee with our philanthropy team about your year-end giving? We would welcome the chance to hear what matters most to you.

Warmly,
The Miami Foundation’s Philanthropy Team

check_in:email.subject: Checking in from The Miami Foundation
check_in:email.body:
Dear Tomas,

We wanted to check in, and to thank you again for your support.

From The Miami Foundation's work: Zero Drownings Miami-Dade invests in year-round, continuous swim lessons for those who need it most to improve drowning prevention education throughout the county.

A story we're proud of: The Miami Foundation partnered with McDermott Will & Schulte to provide free legal counsel to 17 Miami nonprofits, delivering 398 hours of service valued at more than $500,000.
Where gifts go: The Miami Foundation committed $100,000 to support Spanish-language coverage through elTOQUE and City of Miami coverage through The Florida Trib in partnership with the Coconut Grove Spotlight.

If you have questions or ideas, simply reply to this email. We'd love to hear from you.

With gratitude,
The Miami Foundation philanthropy team
